messages:
marta: Heads-up — pulled g2-14 out of prod. Intermittent Xid 63s and a steady trickle of ECC corrected errors overnight, raising suspicion of a flaky card.
joel: Can you paste the logs you saw?
marta: Kernel snippet pasted below:
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 63, pid=2222, GPU 0000:3b:00.0, channel 0000:00:00
[ 1234.568000] NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus
[ 1234.570000] mcelog: corrected ECC error on GPU 0
```
nina: Looks similar to last month's intermittent bus-reset pattern but frequency is lower. Any thermal anomalies?
marta: Temp graph shows short spikes to ~84°C but fans spin-up fine. I'm starting an overnight lab run with targeted thermal cycling + mem/vram stress on the node (soakbench variant).
burnin-bot: Scheduled job 2026-03-18T03:00Z -> 8h: 'flake-hunt-g2-14' on node g2-14
sachin: For repro I recommend combining continuous PCI exerciser with nv-hostctrl logging. Example quick loop: `while true; do sudo ./pci_stress --duration 600; sleep 10; done` and keep `dmesg -w` piped to a logger. Also enable nv-hostctrl debug.
joel: Can we repro in a small isolated lab slice first before committing production racks? If no repro in 8h we either return to pool or escalate RMA depending on ECC trajectory.
nina: Agreed. Proposed policy: lab reproducer overnight + if >=3 Xid or ECC corrected crosses a threshold within 24h -> vendor RMA. Tag node `quarantine:potential-flaky-gpu`.
marta: Note on cost: reserving dedicated lab racks for long runs eats capacity. Cheap option: 8h lab run then move node to preemptible soak cluster for 48h if still flaky. Keeps Dedicated capacity available.
sachin: Ops playbook (short):
```
1) Drain node: infractl drain g2-14 --reason 'flake-hunt'
2) Run reproducer: ./soakbench --pattern pci-exerciser --duration 8h --log /tmp/soak.log
3) Attach hw telemetry: /opt/telemetry/collect.sh g2-14 --interval 10s
4) If Xid >= 3 OR corrected ECC > 100 -> escalate to hw-team (include logs + soak artifacts)
```
joel: Who opens the RMA ticket if we hit threshold? @nina?
nina: Yep I will open with vendor. Need serial, last 7 days dmesg, and soakbench output.
marta: Starting lab run now on node g2-14. Will post progress and attach logs in the morning. :thumbsup:
joel: Please add the quarantine tag in the console so schedulers avoid it.
burnin-bot: Job update: 02:30 elapsed, 0 Xid observed, 12 ECC correctable events on GPU0
marta: Not ideal but expected during early cycles. Continuing run and switching to extended memtest at 05:00 UTC.
nina: If Xid doesn't show but ECC continues to climb, be prepared to run extended VRAM passes (memtest) and a targeted thermal soak at elevated temperatures for 6+ hours.
sachin: Another tweak: add kernel param `drain_disable=1` in the userspace harness to force bus-reset paths and expose flaky PCI links faster. Also capture `lspci -vvv` before/after.
marta: Copy. Switching to extended memtest now. Will upload /tmp/soak.log and telemetry dump when done.
joel: FYI, coordinate with capacity manager for a potential scheduled RMA removal window later this week if we escalate.
marta: Will do. Thanks all, posting artifacts after run.
